_metadata.description: Logo candidates: explore, import, refine with lineage, pick, reject and restore. A pick promotes a candidate to the brand's canonical mark, vectorizing a raster pick first.

requirements.title: Explore logo candidates in one request
requirements.description: Explore takes a brief, a list of concepts and a variations count (1..4) and produces one stored candidate per concept and variation, each recording its prompt, concept, role, model, seed and origin. The service caps concepts at 8 and variations at 4.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: Import an existing image as a candidate
requirements.description: Import creates a proposed candidate from uploaded bytes or an existing asset, with origin IMPORTED and a concept label, optionally recording a parent candidate.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: Refine a candidate with lineage
requirements.description: Refine always creates a new proposed candidate whose parent_id points at its source. An instruction calls edit_instruct; a mask calls object_removal; remove_background calls background_removal; vectorize calls the image-tools vectorize op.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: Pick a candidate and set the brand mark
requirements.description: Pick moves the current pick to superseded then sets the new candidate to picked in one transaction, and sets brand.mark_asset_id to the picked mark. A raster pick is vectorized first and the VECTORIZED child is the one picked.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: Reject and restore candidates
requirements.description: Reject and restore are status changes only and never mutate the underlying asset.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: One picked candidate per brand
requirements.description: A unique partial index enforces exactly one picked candidate per brand, so a concurrent or repeated pick cannot leave two canonical marks.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.
